contexts.text: It is contrary to order for the posterior to inflow into the prior...

Thus the posterior things of the Word appear to them, and not the anterior ones; that is, the exterior things, and not the interior; and to see the posterior or exterior things without the anterior or interior ones, is to see nothing of the Divine. Treated of.
For what is prior must be in what is posterior, for what is posterior to be.
The posterior state is when he is in the good of charity and thence in the truths of faith. Explained.
The hinder parts of the habitation () = the ultimate of Heaven.
Thou shalt see My back parts () = that they should see the externals of the Word, of the Church, and of worship. Explained. AE 412:13.

The reason the back parts of Jehovah = (the above), is that faces = internals; and those are said to see the back parts of Jehovah, and not the faces, who believe and adore the Word, but only its external...
But those who do not believe in the Word do not see even the back parts of Jehovah... These are meant by those who are said to turn their back parts to the temple (). Further illustrated.
The posterior does not act from itself, but from the prior...
The back parts of God (which Moses saw) mean the things visible in the world; and, in special, the things perceptible in the Word.
All posterior things are receptacles of prior ones...
Does not the posterior, as it comes forth from the prior, also subsist from it...
The hinder sea () = the natural man as to truth.
The posterior part, where the haemorrhoid was () = the natural love which is with those who are not spiritual, and which is the love of the world.
The men of the Most Ancient Church were not forbidden to procure Knowledges... but they were forbidden to view these Knowledges by a posterior way. Explained.
